[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Anvil Rock | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=089 }} [[Anvil Rock]] is an area that takes its name from [[Anvil Rock (landmark)|a tall mountain]] in the shape of an anvil. Small groups of [[Minotaur]]s patrol the central bit of the area as well as the north, whilst groups of Stone Summit and [[Centaur]]s can be found in the south. Some [[Dryder]]s can also be found. ==Getting there== *Leaving from [[The Frost Gate (outpost)|the Frost Gate]] *Head west from [[Yak's Bend]] through [[Iron Horse Mine]] if you have not completed [[Borlis Pass]]. *Head north through [[Deldrimor Bowl]] if coming from [[Lion's Arch]]. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s: *Northeast, at the exit into [[Iron Horse Mine]]. *Southeast, at the exit into [[The Frost Gate (outpost)|the Frost Gate]]. *Southwest, at the exit into [[Deldrimor Bowl]]. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== [[Dwarf]] ([[Deldrimor]]) *{{x}} 10 (20) [[Maccus Ironjaw]] ([[collector]] for 5 [[Curved Minotaur Horn]]s) *{{x}} 10 (20) [[Sander the Gray]] (collector for 5 [[Frostfire Fang]]s) *{{w}} 10 (20) [[Dwarven Soldier]] *{{r}} 10 (20) [[Dwarven Scout]] *{{mo}} 10 (20) [[Dwarven Mender]] ===Foes=== [[Animal]]s *{{x}} 5 (5) [[Snow Wolf]] [[Centaur]]s *{{w}} 8 (23) [[Shiverpeak Warrior]] *{{r}} 8 (23) [[Shiverpeak Longbow]] *{{mo}} 8 (23) [[Shiverpeak Protector]] [[Dryder]]s *{{n}} 10 (24) [[Frostfire Dryder]] [[Dwarves]] ([[Stone Summit]]) *{{w}} 10 (24) [[Stone Summit Crusher]] *{{w}} 9 (24) [[Summit Axe Wielder]] *{{w}} 13 (24) [[Summit Beastmaster]] *{{r}} 9 (23) [[Stone Summit Scout]] *{{mo}} 11 (24) [[Dolyak Rider]] *{{n}} 10 (24) [[Stone Summit Howler]] *{{me}} 10 (24) [[Stone Summit Sage]] [[Minotaur]]s *{{w}} 10 (24) [[Minotaur (Shiverpeaks)|Minotaur]] ====Bosses==== [[Centaur]]s *{{r}} 11 (27) [[Rubi Spottedmane]] *{{mo}} 11 (27) [[Jolo Lighthaunch]] [[Dryder]]s *{{me}} 12 (27) [[Frostfire Dryder (mesmer boss)|Frostfire Dryder]] *{{e}} 12 (27) [[Frostfire Dryder (elementalist boss)|Frostfire Dryder]] [[Dwarves]] ([[Stone Summit]]) *{{n}} 12 (27) [[Riine Windrot]] [[Minotaur]]s *{{w}} 13 (27) [[Minotaur (boss)|Minotaur]] ==Notes== *These quests will affect the spawns in this area: ** [[Reunion]] *There is a small Dwarven village in the southern area of the map. On a random chance per map instance, about 5 waves of [[Frostfire Dryder]]s will attack (totaling to about 30 Dryders). The allied [[Dwarven Soldier]]s there will fight with you. Depending on where you entered the map, those Dwarven allies may already have been killed by the time you reach their location. The Dryders can also get stuck on the way to the village from [[Deldrimor Bowl]] so if you are looking for a missed wave check along that path. *Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.9% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title. **There is an area in the mountain range just northeast of Ice Tooth Cave where you can explore a fair distance farther north than on the field. The ridge is large enough that several Snow Wolves may spawn along it. *{{Vanquisher|count = 233|low = 209|high = 252}} **The [[Centaur]] boss [[Jolo Lighthaunch]]'s healing may prove difficult to overcome if you party lacks firepower or [[interrupt]]s, especially if two [[Shiverpeak Protector]]s spawned in its group. Consider defeating this boss right at the start. The group is large, and strays far from its origin point. Pulling them so they are bodyblocked by the nearest cliff corner and having your team hold them for AoE damage is suggested. **In the Southeast of the area, there is a small road leading to [[the Frost Gate (outpost)|the Frost Gate]] [[outpost]]. There are Dwarven and Minotaur groups that patrol that path, and they may be easily missed during vanquishing. **Some minotaur groups patrol in very large circles at a fast pace, both clockwise and counter-clockwise around the center. If you're looking for the last mob and can't find it, try circling the center of the map one way, then the other. Also check the north-south path in the far eastern part of the map. **Centaurs and minotaurs are hostile to each other. {{anomaly|A few groups of Centaurs have been reported to be hostile to each other.}} == Trivia == * This area is the site of [[The Great Snowball Fight of the Gods]]. {{Explorable areas in the Northern Shiverpeaks}} [[de:Ambossstein]]
